liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): Clarence Clemons sat in with the band and made this a spirited version; Clarence Clemons appeared as an unannounced guest, and the song was very hot, leading into serious far-out playing [18][23]
- **Never Trust A Woman** (1 review): Brent kicked back his piano bench and pounded the keys Jerry Lee Lewis-style; the recording doesn't fully capture the verve [22]
- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Jerry's solos here as a nice one [22]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): The ripping highlight; Brent pushed the jam harder, and it peaked repeatedly in the middle [23]
- The reviewer found this version unusually weird, with odd energy that carried into the 12/31/89 Dark Star [18]
- Reviewer's highlight of the show [19]
- This version gets really far out [25]
- The Playin' > Crazy Fingers > Uncle John's Band sequence is singled out as great [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-12-27.142683.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 165 min [1]
- **gd1989-12-27.142852.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1989-12-27.144151.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-12-27.142853.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [4]
- **gd89-12-27.aud.wiley.8960.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 162 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the audience recording's sound as crystal clear [29]
- **gd89-12-27.schoeps.ladner.20785.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 162 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer feels the recording has lots of psychedelic Brent fills but doesn't fully convey Brent's energy; Clear, well-balanced mix with no audible talkers around the taper [22][25]

## Around the show

- Jerry danced and swayed in front of his mike, playing like a showman, at times recalling Buddy Guy [21]
- Clarence Clemmons joined on Iko Iko, Playing In The Band, The Wheel and I Need A Miracle [2]
- Clarence Clemmons joined on Iko Iko, Playing In The Band, The Wheel and I Need A Miracle [4]
- The strange energy of this night resurfaced at the 12/31/89 show, whose Dark Star the reviewer thinks is underrated [18]
- Fans awaited Help>Slip, Dark Star and Attics played on the East Coast months earlier, but those were not played; the show foreshadows a strong Spring 1990 [19]
- Reviewer sees this show as the bookend opposite the New Year's show, which was also great [23]
- Reviewer wishes Dark Star had replaced Crazy Fingers, which would have made it a night for the ages [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-12-27.142683.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC3/MK4 mics > Aerco PreAmp (w/ Oade capacitor mod) > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k);… [1]
- **gd1989-12-27.142852.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [2]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to complete the show; this set is 24-bit converted to 16-bit at 44.1 [2]
- **gd1989-12-27.144151.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (44/16) [3]. Also: This matrix was mixed by an archive.org user and converted to FLAC in December 2018 [3]
- **gd1989-12-27.142853.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [4]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to make the show complete [4]
- **gd89-12-27.aud.wiley.8960.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>DAT>CDR [6]
- **gd89-12-27.schoeps.ladner.20785.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB>Shoeps CMC3/mk-4 > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 [9]
